basic_info.description: Fully remodeled with permits (2017), with views in the Portola neighborhood, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers breathtaking 180-degree views from both levels. The upper level features 2 bright bedrooms and 1 bath, while the lower level boasts a generous family room, a third bedroom, and a full bath, providing flexibility as a separate 2/1 suite or extended living space. The open living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto a large deck, perfect for entertaining or relaxing while enjoying serene city lights and shipyard views.  Located just 3 blocks from the expansive Palega Recreation Centeroffering open fields, a soccer field, basketball courts, and more! You'll also enjoy proximity to local shops, restaurants, and convenient freeway access, combining tranquility with urban convenience. Situated on one of Portola's best blocks, this home truly captures the charm and vibrancy of the neighborhood.
